description: Given a target allocation, computes the buy and sell amounts per asset that would move a Solana wallet toward it. The allocation base is USDC plus held xStocks and yield tokens (SOL is excluded as gas reserve). Each asset gets current %, target %, drift, deltaUsd (+buy / -sell) and an action; assets within the drift threshold are left alone, and held assets missing from the target are flagged to sell. Read-only: it only computes suggestions.

driftThresholdPct.description: Only suggest a trade if drift exceeds this (default 3%).

minTradeUsd.description: Suppress trades smaller than this USD amount (default 1).

targets.description: Target allocation. Each item: { asset, percent }. asset is a ticker (NVDA, SPY), a yield-token symbol (USDY), or 'USDC' for cash. Percents should sum to ~100.

name: suggest_rebalance

actions.description: Suggested buys/sells/deposits to reach the targets

driftThresholdPct.description: Drift below which no action is suggested

targetsSumPct.description: Sum of the requested target percentages
